tournament_registration_open.title: Tournament Registration Open!
tournament_registration_open.body_guest: Registration for the tournament has started. Secure your progress now by registering and enter the tournament!
tournament_registration_open.body_user: Registration for the tournament has started. Don't miss your chance to join!

reminder_to_register.title: Reminder to Register!
reminder_to_register.body_guest: You haven't registered for the tournament yet. Secure your progress now and enter the tournament! {{participantsCount}} users have already registered.
reminder_to_register.body_user: You haven't registered for the tournament yet. Register now! {{participantsCount}} users have already registered.

last_day_to_register.title: Last Day to Register!
last_day_to_register.body_guest: Today is the last day to register for the tournament. Secure your progress now and enter the tournament! {{participantsCount}} users have already registered.
last_day_to_register.body_user: Today is the last day to register for the tournament. Register now! {{participantsCount}} users have already registered.

all_the_best.title: All the Best for the Tournament!
all_the_best.body: Get ready! The tournament is about to begin. Prepare your strategies now. There are {{participantsCount}} participants competing.

see_you_next_time_guest.title: 🔒 Don’t Miss Out Again!
see_you_next_time_guest.body: The tournament registration has ended, and {{participantsCount}} users are already competing! You missed this one, but don’t worry—secure your progress by creating an account and be ready to join the next tournament!

see_you_next_time_user.title: ⚡ You Missed the Tournament!
see_you_next_time_user.body: The tournament registration has ended, and {{participantsCount}} users are already competing. Don’t worry—you can catch the next one! Stay tuned for more exciting events!

tournament_started.title: 🏆 The Tournament Has Begun!
tournament_started.body: Get ready for an exciting challenge! Wishing you the best of luck! 💪

day_1_completed.title: 🏆 Day 1 of the Tournament Completed!
day_1_completed.body: Day 1 is over! Check your rank on the leaderboard and see how you performed. Keep pushing! 💪

day_2.title: 🔥 Day 2 of the Tournament!
day_2.body: The tournament is halfway there! Keep the momentum going and show them what you’ve got! 💥

tournament_completed.title: 🎉 Tournament Completed!
tournament_completed.body: The tournament has come to an end. Thank you for your amazing participation! We hope you had a great time!

next_time_guest.title: 🔒 Secure Your Spot for the Next Tournament!
next_time_guest.body: The tournament has ended, but you can still be part of the action next time! Create an account to save your progress and get ready for future challenges!

next_time_user.title: Don’t Miss Out Next Time!
next_time_user.body: The tournament has ended, but there's always another chance! Stay tuned and register early for the next event!
